ckpt_cfg.arch: separable: FourierFeat-MLP g(x)->R^r  x  MLP-head h(z)->R^r, hard poly BC; NO POD anywhere
ckpt_cfg.objective: weak alpha=1 M=64, NNLS-EQ m=256 grid nodes
ckpt_cfg.timing: pipe = f_m projection + LM solve + full-grid decode; balanced alternating-order schedule over all ROM and CG arms; raw reps retained; error extracted from a timed invocation's output

config.objective: weak alpha=1 M=64 (incumbent sep_poisson.py conventions: Wl=lam^(1-alpha), f_m=lam^-alpha Phi^T f)

paths.full: all interior nodes, exact weights (wq=1), cached bank G_all (reference)
paths.eq: incumbent NNLS-EQ m=256 grid nodes, cached bank
paths.qf: r(z)=Wl*(B h(z))-f_m, B=PhiT_all @ (wq_all*G_all) precomputed once; NO quadrature points

config.timing: balanced forward/reversed sweeps per source (sc.balanced_time), raw reps retained, error from the captured timed invocation (source->f_m projection inside the timed region)

Q_solutions.rule: resid<=1e-12 AND (grad_rel<=1e-10 OR grad_abs<=1e-12); grad_abs = ||g_qf-g_full||/(||J_full||_F ||r_full||), the ladder's c1_abs normalisation (g cancels near solver stops)

setup.note: G_all is also the shared full-field readout bank every path's timed pipe decodes with (the incumbent cached arm builds it too), so the marginal QF setup over the incumbent is only qf_b_matmul_s; the EQ path additionally pays eq_nnls_fit_s + eq_bank_and_table_s.
